description: Get historical price series for supported commodity indicators using the exact slugs advertised by this schema. Supported indicators: crude_oil_inventories, crude_oil_stocks, distillate_inventories, distillate_stocks, gasoline_inventories, gasoline_stocks, gold, natural_gas, natural_gas_storage, natural_gas_storage_level, oil_brent, oil_wti, platinum, silver. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

indicator.description: Commodity indicator slug. Supported: crude_oil_inventories, crude_oil_stocks, distillate_inventories, distillate_stocks, gasoline_inventories, gasoline_stocks, gold, natural_gas, natural_gas_storage, natural_gas_storage_level, oil_brent, oil_wti, platinum, silver.

latest.description: Set true for one snapshot of the latest stored value of every commodity indicator; `indicator` is then not needed.

symbol.description: Backward-compatible alias for `indicator`, which supersedes it in new calls.

name: commodities
title: Commodity Indicators
